response.sql: WITH channel_avgs AS (SELECT AVG(f.feerate) as channel_avg FROM fees f JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault WHERE f.feerate IS NOT NULL GROUP BY o.orderbase), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(f.feerate) as overall_avg FROM fees f JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault WHERE f.feerate IS NOT NULL), above_avg AS (SELECT ca.channel_avg, oa.overall_avg, ca.channel_avg - oa.overall_avg as distance_above FROM channel_avgs ca CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa WHERE ca.channel_avg > oa.overall_avg) SELECT AVG(channel_avg) as mean_fee_rate, AVG(distance_above) as avg_distance_above_average FROM above_avg
